title: Greenway Foods Opens New Distribution Center
L: Greenway Foods opened a new distribution center in Milton last week.
The 20,000-square-meter facility will allow the company to deliver fresh produce to stores across the region more quickly.
Deliveries that once took two days will now arrive overnight.
According to CEO Laura Mendes, the center will also create around 200 jobs.
Most of the positions will be filled by local residents, and the company plans to start a training program for warehouse workers this fall.
Greenway Foods currently supplies more than 150 supermarkets in three states.

exq.why: Có last week → quá khứ đơn: opened.

exq.a: Deliveries that once took two days will now arrive overnight.
w: Greenway Foods was founded by Laura Mendes's father.
Milton is known for its historic town center.
Fresh produce is popular with local residents.
exq.why: Câu trước: giao hàng nhanh hơn → câu chèn nêu cụ thể (hai ngày còn một đêm).
a training program = chương trình đào tạo (danh từ ghép).
Chủ ngữ là tên một công ty (số ít) + currently → hiện tại đơn ngôi ba số ít: supplies.
